items.detail: Phase 3D: as of 2026-09-07 no reviewed source establishes the round closed. Forbes and The Information continue to describe it as under discussion with terms not final; The Information also reports approximately $50M annualized revenue (third-party estimate). The proposed $350M is not capital raised and the $3.25B is not a completed-transaction valuation. Confirm the outcome before any use as a completed event.
items.guidance: An event was reported but not confirmed to have occurred. Confirm the outcome with a definitive source before it is treated as completed, and do not count it as capital raised.
